failure_modes.recovery: Call myinvois_settings_list to get the profile id, or myinvois_settings_save when the list is empty.
failure_modes.when: the id does not name the supplier profile of your tenant

description: Read the supplier profile by id: the party printed on every e-invoice (company, TIN, BRN, SST and tourism tax numbers, MSIC code, address). Refuses an id outside your tenant with NOT_FOUND: call myinvois_settings_list, which returns the one profile row. NEXT: myinvois_settings_save to change it.
name: myinvois_settings_read
